```{r setup}
experiment_config_relative <- file.path(
  "data", "202609_tp_FAMES_GC-IRMS", "experiment_config.yaml"
)
project_root_candidates <- c(".", "..", "../..", "../../..")
project_root_matches <- project_root_candidates[vapply(
  project_root_candidates,
  function(root) file.exists(file.path(root, experiment_config_relative)),
  logical(1)
)]

if (length(project_root_matches) == 0) {
  stop("Could not locate the FAMES experiment config from the current directory.")
}

project_root <- project_root_matches[[1]]
config_path <- file.path(project_root, experiment_config_relative)
lab_config_dir <- file.path(project_root, "..", "sessions_lab_isotidy_config")
gc_methods_path <- normalizePath(
  file.path(lab_config_dir, "gc_methods.yml"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

config <- load_IRMS_config(config_path, lab_config_dir)
raw_gc <- load_gc_data(config)
gc_method_name <- "YP_CO2_F8_27m"
external_standard_id <- "F8"

# Imported rows should be unique across all instrument fields, even when an
# observation was present in more than one overlapping export.
stopifnot("source_file" %in% names(raw_gc))
stopifnot(nrow(raw_gc) > 0)
gc_yaml <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)$gc
gc_selected_input_set <- gc_yaml$input_sets[[gc_yaml$selected_input_set]]
stopifnot(all(grepl(
  gc_selected_input_set$file_pattern,
  unique(raw_gc$source_file),
  ignore.case = TRUE
)))
gc_observation_fields <- setdiff(names(raw_gc), "source_file")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(raw_gc[, gc_observation_fields, drop = FALSE]))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(raw_gc$source_file) & nzchar(raw_gc$source_file)))
```

## Check replicate summary behavior

This fixture checks that repeated rows within one analysis are first reduced
to one analysis value, then summarized across analytical replicates. The
standard row should be omitted.

```{r replicate-summary-check}
replicate_fixture <- data.frame(
  run_id = "fixture_run",
  method_name = "fixture_method",
  sample_id = c("sample_A", "sample_A", "sample_A", "F8"),
  injection_id = c("1", "1", "1", "1"),
  analysis_no = c("analysis_1", "analysis_1", "analysis_2", "analysis_3"),
  element = "C",
  isotope = "C13",
  compound_id = "FA_1",
  is_external_standard = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
  delta_value_final = c(8, 12, 14, 999)
)
gc_replicate_schema <- list(replicates = list(
  identify_by = "analysis_no",
  group_column = "sample_id"
))
replicate_summary <- summarize_replicates(
  data = replicate_fixture,
  peripheral = "GC",
  schema = gc_replicate_schema,
  verbose = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(replicate_summary) == 1)
stopifnot(replicate_summary$sample_id[[1]] == "sample_A")
stopifnot(replicate_summary$n_replicates[[1]] == 2L)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  replicate_summary$delta_value_final_mean[[1]], 12
)))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  replicate_summary$delta_value_final_sd[[1]], sqrt(8)
)))
replicate_summary
```

## Process GC peaks through external-standard correction

```{r process-gc}
gc_result <- process_gc(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name,
  external_standard_id = external_standard_id,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = TRUE
)

gc_result$daily_offsets
stopifnot(is.data.frame(gc_result$visualization_data))
stopifnot("delta_value_final_mean" %in% names(gc_result$visualization_data))
stopifnot("delta_value_final_sd" %in% names(gc_result$visualization_data))
```

## Check daily offsets and standard injection exclusions

Each injection offset is the mean of its matched compound offsets. The daily
offset is the unweighted mean of included injection offsets for that date.
Injection IDs are checked together with their correction date because an ID
may occur on more than one date.

```{r standard-offset-check}
expected_daily_offsets <- gc_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::group_by(correction_date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    delta_offset = mean(delta_offset),
    n_injections = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
actual_daily_offsets <- gc_result$daily_offsets |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  expected_daily_offsets,
  actual_daily_offsets,
  check.attributes = FALSE
)))

excluded_standard_id <- as.character(
  gc_result$injection_offsets$injection_id[[1]]
)
gc_standard_exclusion_result <- process_gc(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name,
  external_standard_id = external_standard_id,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = FALSE,
  exclude_standard_injection_ids = excluded_standard_id
)
stopifnot(excluded_standard_id %in%
  gc_standard_exclusion_result$excluded_standard_injection_ids)
stopifnot(!(excluded_standard_id %in%
  as.character(gc_standard_exclusion_result$injection_offsets$injection_id)))
# Standard rows remain reviewable in the processed data; only their offsets are
# excluded from the correction calculation.
stopifnot(any(as.character(gc_standard_exclusion_result$data$injection_id) ==
  excluded_standard_id))
expected_after_exclusion <- gc_standard_exclusion_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::group_by(correction_date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    delta_offset = mean(delta_offset),
    n_injections = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
actual_after_exclusion <- gc_standard_exclusion_result$daily_offsets |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  expected_after_exclusion,
  actual_after_exclusion,
  check.attributes = FALSE
)))
```

## Check manual peak exclusions

Manual exclusions are selected explicitly by analysis and peak. The selector
can target a sample or standard peak. This check targets an F8 peak so it can
verify the effect on its injection offset. The selector is applied before
offset calculation, and excluded rows are kept in the exclusion audit table.

```{r manual-exclusion-check}
gc_review <- adapt_gc_data(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = FALSE,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name
)
standard_candidates <- gc_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::filter(n_compounds >= 2) |>
  dplyr::pull(injection_id)
stopifnot(length(standard_candidates) > 0)
manual_standard_id <- as.character(standard_candidates[[1]])
manual_reference_id <- gc_result$external_reference_id
manual_reference_compounds <- config$stds_reference_df |>
  dplyr::filter(as.character(standard_id) == manual_reference_id) |>
  dplyr::pull(compound_id) |>
  as.character()
manual_standard_row <- gc_review |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(injection_id) == manual_standard_id,
    compound_match_status == "matched",
    as.character(compound_id) %in% manual_reference_compounds,
    !as.character(compound_id) %in% as.character(
      config$gc_standards$external$exclude_compound_ids
    ),
    is.finite(delta_value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice(1)
stopifnot(nrow(manual_standard_row) == 1)

manual_exclusion <- data.frame(
  analysis_no = as.character(manual_standard_row$analysis_no),
  peak_number = manual_standard_row$peak_number,
  reason = "Markdown functionality check"
)
manual_key_rows <- gc_review |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(analysis_no) == manual_exclusion$analysis_no[[1]],
    as.character(peak_number) == as.character(manual_exclusion$peak_number[[1]])
  )
stopifnot(nrow(manual_key_rows) > 0)

gc_manual_exclusion_result <- process_gc(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name,
  external_standard_id = external_standard_id,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = FALSE,
  exclude_measurements = manual_exclusion
)
if (nrow(gc_manual_exclusion_result$unmatched_measurement_exclusions) > 0) {
  print(gc_manual_exclusion_result$unmatched_measurement_exclusions)
  stop("The manually selected GC peak did not match.")
}
stopifnot(nrow(gc_manual_exclusion_result$excluded_measurements) ==
  nrow(manual_key_rows))
stopifnot(all(gc_manual_exclusion_result$excluded_measurements$exclusion_reason ==
  "Markdown functionality check"))
stopifnot(!any(
  as.character(gc_manual_exclusion_result$data$analysis_no) ==
    manual_exclusion$analysis_no[[1]] &
    as.character(gc_manual_exclusion_result$data$peak_number) ==
      as.character(manual_exclusion$peak_number[[1]])
))
manual_standard_date <- as.Date(manual_standard_row$start_time[[1]])
baseline_standard_count <- gc_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(injection_id) == manual_standard_id,
    correction_date == manual_standard_date
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(n_compounds)
manual_standard_count <- gc_manual_exclusion_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(injection_id) == manual_standard_id,
    correction_date == manual_standard_date
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(n_compounds)
excluded_standard_peak_count <- manual_key_rows |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.Date(start_time) == manual_standard_date,
    as.character(compound_id) %in% manual_reference_compounds,
    is.finite(delta_value)
  ) |>
  nrow()
stopifnot(length(baseline_standard_count) == 1)
if (length(manual_standard_count) == 0) {
  manual_standard_count <- 0L
}
stopifnot(length(manual_standard_count) == 1)
stopifnot(manual_standard_count ==
  baseline_standard_count - excluded_standard_peak_count)

expected_manual_daily_offsets <- gc_manual_exclusion_result$injection_offsets |>
  dplyr::group_by(correction_date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    delta_offset = mean(delta_offset),
    n_injections = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
actual_manual_daily_offsets <- gc_manual_exclusion_result$daily_offsets |>
  dplyr::arrange(correction_date)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  expected_manual_daily_offsets,
  actual_manual_daily_offsets,
  check.attributes = FALSE
)))

# Manual selectors can live in the experiment config instead of being passed
# to process_gc() for each call.
config_with_manual_exclusion <- config
config_with_manual_exclusion$processing$gc$exclude_measurements <- list(
  as.list(manual_exclusion[1, , drop = FALSE])
)
gc_config_exclusion_result <- process_gc(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config_with_manual_exclusion,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name,
  external_standard_id = external_standard_id,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(gc_config_exclusion_result$excluded_measurements) ==
  nrow(manual_key_rows))
stopifnot(all(gc_config_exclusion_result$excluded_measurements$exclusion_reason ==
  "Markdown functionality check"))
```

## Check experiment-wide F8 compound exclusions

An excluded standard compound is omitted from every F8 offset average. Its
measurements remain in the processed data for review.

```{r standard-compound-exclusion-check}
observed_reference_compounds <- intersect(
  manual_reference_compounds,
  unique(as.character(gc_review$compound_id[
    trimws(as.character(gc_review$sample_id)) == external_standard_id
  ]))
)
observed_reference_compounds <- setdiff(
  observed_reference_compounds,
  as.character(config$gc_standards$external$exclude_compound_ids)
)
stopifnot(length(observed_reference_compounds) > 0)
excluded_compound_id <- observed_reference_compounds[[1]]
config_with_compound_exclusion <- config
config_with_compound_exclusion$gc_standards$external$exclude_compound_ids <-
  unique(c(
    as.character(config$gc_standards$external$exclude_compound_ids),
    excluded_compound_id
  ))
gc_compound_exclusion_result <- process_gc(
  raw_df = raw_gc,
  config = config_with_compound_exclusion,
  gc_methods = gc_methods_path,
  method_name = gc_method_name,
  external_standard_id = external_standard_id,
  isotope = "C13",
  verbose = FALSE
)
stopifnot(excluded_compound_id %in%
  gc_compound_exclusion_result$excluded_standard_compound_ids)
stopifnot(any(as.character(gc_compound_exclusion_result$data$compound_id) ==
  excluded_compound_id))
excluded_compound_peak_count <- gc_review |>
  dplyr::filter(
    trimws(as.character(sample_id)) == external_standard_id,
    as.character(compound_id) == excluded_compound_id,
    as.character(compound_id) %in% manual_reference_compounds,
    !is.na(injection_id),
    !is.na(start_time),
    is.finite(delta_value)
  ) |>
  nrow()
stopifnot(
  sum(gc_result$injection_offsets$n_compounds) -
    sum(gc_compound_exclusion_result$injection_offsets$n_compounds) ==
    excluded_compound_peak_count
)
```

## Review compound assignment

Unmatched and ambiguous peaks remain unassigned for review.

```{r compound-assignment-summary}
gc_assignment_summary <- gc_result$data |>
  dplyr::count(compound_match_status, compound_id, name = "n_peaks")
gc_assignment_summary
```

```{r f8-assignments}
f8_assignments <- gc_result$data |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id == external_standard_id) |>
  dplyr::count(injection_id, compound_id, compound_match_status,
               name = "n_peaks") |>
  dplyr::arrange(injection_id, compound_id)
f8_assignments
```

## Save the corrected GC data product

The final output contains raw and externally corrected delta values, compound
assignment status, retention times, peak areas, and injection metadata.
Separate CSV files retain injection-level and daily offsets, and an HTML report
summarizes the processing.

```{r save-gc}
gc_saved <- save_gc_results(
  result = gc_result,
  config = config,
  output_dir = file.path(project_root, config$output_dir),
  prefix = config$file_name,
  verbose = TRUE
)
stopifnot(file.exists(gc_saved$data_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(gc_saved$visualization_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(gc_saved$excluded_measurements_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(gc_saved$injection_offsets_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(gc_saved$daily_offsets_file))
gc_saved
```
